findings.location: Paragraph: "Die humaniste, met al hul redenasie, bespot die very bestaan van God."
findings.source_quote: The humanists, with all their reasoning, mock the very existence of God.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the erroneous English word "very" with the correct Afrikaans equivalent, e.g. "werklike": "… bespot die werklike bestaan van God."
findings.translation_quote: Die humaniste, met al hul redenasie, bespot die very bestaan van God.

findings.location: Paragraph: "Nee, nee, gee nie die kredit aan God nie."
findings.source_quote: No, no, don’t give the credit to God.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the Afrikaans spelling of "krediet": "Nee, nee, gee nie die krediet aan God nie."
findings.translation_quote: Nee, nee, gee nie die kredit aan God nie.

findings.location: Opening paragraph: sequence of em dashes
findings.source_quote: Or a better question might be, have you seen God working in your life? Do others see God working in your life?
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the HTML entity sequence and long run of em dashes with an idiomatic Afrikaans punctuation or a single em dash. Example: "Of dalk — is die beter vraag: het jy God in jou lewe sien werk?"
findings.translation_quote: Of dalk – – – – – – – – is die beter vraag: het jy God in jou lewe sien werk?

findings.location: Sentence: "Voordat hy terug China toe vertrek het"
findings.source_quote: Before departing back to China, he was asked what impressed him most about the churches in America.
findings.suggested_fix: Improve Afrikaans word order and include preposition for clarity. For example: "Voordat hy terug na China vertrek het, is hy gevra…"
findings.translation_quote: Voordat hy terug China toe vertrek het, is hy gevra wat hom die meeste beïndruk het aan die kerke in Amerika.

findings.location: Paragraph: "Die woordeboek omskryf humanisme soos volg; ’n siening..."
findings.source_quote: The dictionary defines humanism like this; an outlook or system of thought attaching prime importance to human rather than divine or supernatural matters.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a colon rather than a semicolon for introducing a definition in Afrikaans: "Die woordeboek omskryf humanisme soos volg: ’n siening..."
findings.translation_quote: Die woordeboek omskryf humanisme soos volg; ’n siening of denkstelsel wat primêre belang aan die mens eerder as die goddelike of bonatuurlike heg.
